title: Google Drive Document Retrieval
query: Tell me about the helicopter racing league
expected_behavior: Must query 1P Google Drive connector, retrieve relevant enterprise documents regarding the helicopter racing league, and return a grounded response with source citations.
semantic_contract: The response must synthesize and present factual information about the helicopter racing league retrieved from Google Drive documents. It must NOT be a refusal message, an error, or an ungrounded generic answer.

title: Deep Research Multi-Step Plan & Synthesis
expected_behavior: Must trigger Deep Research Agent via agentsSpec, generate structured Research Plan and research questions accordions, and emit session token.
semantic_contract: The response must demonstrate authentic execution of the Deep Research Agent by generating a structured, comprehensive multi-step research plan and in-depth synthesis exploring project management methodologies (such as Agile, Waterfall, Scrum, Kanban, Lean). It must NOT be a shallow one-paragraph answer, a refusal message, or a planner/turns error.

title: Public Google Search Web Grounding
query: What are the latest announced Google Cloud Singapore regional capabilities this year?
expected_behavior: Must invoke Google Search web grounding spec and provide real-time facts with clickable web citations.
semantic_contract: The response must provide specific, factual regional capabilities announced for Google Cloud Singapore (such as data residency, model availability, or regional ML processing) grounded with factual web search citations.
